column1: Every Shipment Zero delivery begins its journey at fulfilment and sort
centres powered by 100 % renewable energy. More than 50 Amazon
facilities around the world are powered by solar roofs, which can
generate as much as 80 % of a single fulfilment facility’s annual energy
needs. To reach 100 % renewable energy, we invest in large-scale wind
and solar projects that distribute energy onto the grid for our use.
